kapak.alt: The stapedius and our own voice

youtube.baslik: What happens in your ear just before you start speaking? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The stapedius muscle in the middle ear also contracts just before we start to speak. The contraction reduces the energy reaching the inner ear, especially at low frequencies, and helps our own voice sound softer to us.
